top_signals.title: US Stock Futures Fall as Anthropic IPO Fails to Quell AI Worries
top_signals.summary: US equity futures extended losses on Friday after Anthropic PBC’s stock-market debut failed to stem concerns around the AI trade. The Claude chatbot maker dropped more than 6% in early trading on Friday, partly reversing its first day’s 17% gain.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Hackers steal data of 1.6 million SBC Medical Group customers
top_signals.summary: SBC Medical Group has warned in a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) that two cybersecurity incidents exposed sensitive customer and employee information, including personal data belonging to 1.6 million people. [...]

top_signals.title: UK court confirms British government served Apple with secret encryption notice
top_signals.summary: The British government served Apple with a secret legal notice targeting the company’s cryptographic protections for iCloud accounts, a tribunal has confirmed, ending almost two years of official refusal to acknowledge what had been widely reported.
